## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks you ran and their results. Include platforms/devices and screenshots or recordings for visual changes. State anything you could not test.

## Compatibility and documentation

Note API changes, platform limitations, and updates to the effect catalog or changelog.

For every codebase change (including tests, refactors, tooling, and CI), complete
both updates in this PR. See `AGENTS.md` for the change-to-guide map.

- [ ] Updated `README.md` with a concise, relevant explanation.
- [ ] Updated the affected Markdown guide(s) in `docs/` with accurate details.
- [ ] Preserved the README banner and all four inline sample recordings.
- [ ] Ran the documentation source checks, tests, strict build, and site checks.

Prose-only and media-only changes do not require companion edits. Code changes
cannot bypass the documentation check with a PR-body rationale.
